mapper.select: SELECT id, scenario_id, version_no, status, start_node_id, created_by, published_at, created_at FROM scenario_version WHERE scenario_id = #{scenarioId} ORDER BY version_no DESC

SELECT id, scenario_id, version_no, status, start_node_id, created_by, published_at, created_at FROM scenario_version WHERE scenario_id = #{scenarioId} AND status = 'DRAFT' ORDER BY version_no DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, scenario_id, version_no, status, start_node_id, created_by, published_at, created_at FROM scenario_version WHERE scenario_id = #{scenarioId} AND status = 'PUBLISHED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scenario_version (scenario_id, version_no, status, created_by) VALUES (#{scenarioId}, #{versionNo}, #{status}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE scenario_version SET status = 'ARCHIVED' WHERE scenario_id = #{scenarioId} AND status = 'PUBLISHED'
UPDATE scenario_version SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
